messages:
sara_sales: Quick help needed 3> Customer wants a concise list of artifacts to sign POC acceptance. deadline EOW. also asked if dedicated pricing must be agreed before POC and whether we can share the full pen-test report vs redacted.

mike_ps: Typical minimal set we hand over: SOC 2 Type II attestation (or controls summary), pen-test attestation letter (or redacted executive summary), network diagram for staging/UAT, SSO integration notes + test account, list of staging IPs or VPN details, data residency statement, and a short POC runbook (support hours, SLAs).

mike_ps: On pricing: no, a dedicated reserved pool is not required to run a POC. we do offer a short-term reserved window if they need guaranteed latency; that is quoted separately and not a blocker to start.

jordan_security: About the pen-test: we can provide a signed attestation template that says tests were run within last 12 months and no critical findings, or provide a redacted summary. full reports require an NDA + limited dataroom access. security prefers to provide attestation + redacted summary for speed.

jordan_security: If they insist on raw findings, we need CISO/legal sign-off and ops to prepare a secure share. also note we will not disclose vulnerability scanner credentials or internal vendor PII.

alex_sre: For staging IPs: default ephemeral CIDR window we offer for POC is 10.11.12.0/28 for ingress and 10.11.13.0/29 for callbacks. we can do static public IPs for a longer-term window but that requires a ticket and ~3 business days lead time. static IPs may also change billing if reserved infra is needed.

alex_sre: Example whitelist snippet they can paste into firewall:
```
- UAT ingress: 10.11.12.0/28
- Control callbacks: 10.11.13.0/29
- Management/API: 10.11.14.5
```

sara_sales: Can someone turn this into a one-page checklist i can send to the buyer? they specifically asked: "if we give network diagram + SSO + pen-test letter, is that normally enough for signoff?"

mike_ps: Usually yes. minimal acceptance checklist to propose:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation OR controls summary (signed)
- Pen-test attestation letter OR redacted exec summary (no outstanding critical findings statement)
- Network architecture diagram (staging/UAT + any on-prem connectors)
- SSO/SAML test user validated in staging
- Confirmation of staging IP whitelist or VPN details
- POC support hours and escalation contact
- If requested: KMS/key custody statement or HSM integration note

mike_ps: Add a line that any high findings must include remediation ETA. we can tolerate low/medium items during POC with documented plan.

jordan_security: I'll drop the standard pen-test attestation template into the email thread you send (can redline if their legal requests changes). security will sign the technical attestation; legal should sign contractual language if they request an addendum.

sara_sales: Great. i'll send the checklist and ask whether they want redacted summary vs full report. will capture buyer legal contact. tagging y'all if they push for full report or ask for static IPs.

alex_sre: FYI if they want static public IPs for a month we need ops lead time and maybe a small infra commit; ping me and i'll open the ticket.

mike_ps: happy to be on a quick call to walk them through the checklist and pricing tradeoffs.

sara_sales: thanks team :thumbsup:
